mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is currently overcast at the Verona Public Library with a full moon visible, and we are expecting an overnight low of 64 degrees with no rain predicted.

Road surface treatment is scheduled across city streets from August 4 to 7, so watch for no parking signs. Additionally, the city offers rebates for high efficiency toilets and rain barrels to help with water conservation.

There is plenty to do with Concerts in the Park and trivia at Hop Haus occurring today. Looking ahead, Verona Area High School hosts a medical clinic and the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree takes place on August 1.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Saturday, July 26, a driver was arrested for an O W I after being clocked at 97 miles per hour on the highway.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle, and you have until 10 PM tonight to get your fix. If you miss out, look forward to Raspberry Cheesecake tomorrow.
